preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(n) <= 300000 for n in stdin.split()[1::2])
preconditions.description: Each number of rooms n in each test case is between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == int(n) for n, s in zip(stdin.split()[1::2], stdin.split()[2::2]))
preconditions.description: Each string s in each test case has length equal to the corresponding number of rooms n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '<>-' for c in s) for s in stdin.split()[2::2])
preconditions.description: Each string s in each test case consists only of the characters '<', '>', and '-'.
The sum of all room counts n among all test cases does not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(int(count) == sum(1 for i in range(int(n)) if is_returnable_room(i, s)) for count, n, s in zip(stdout.split(), stdin.split()[1::2], stdin.split()[2::2]))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains the number of returnable rooms for the corresponding test case.
